card.name: First piece of a brand drug name
card.fires_on: The first letter or piece of a brand-name drug (e.g. L, B, Y) that begins right after words like 'to', 'with', 'of', or 'during' in drug-label text. It also fires on a few words just before a drug name.

modes.label: Opening letter of brand name
modes.description: A single capital letter that starts an uppercase brand name split into pieces.

modes.label: Word before a drug name
modes.description: A word such as 'another' or 'a' that sits where a drug name is expected next.
modes.example: Higher rate of MACE (defined as cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, and stroke) with<< another>> JAK inhibitor vs. TNF blockers

card.plain: It lights up at the very start of a drug brand name that the text is spelling out in pieces.
